subject.title: fix(macos): stop in-place update from respawning itself forever

question: Should the macOS app treat five failed handoffs for one replacement hash as terminal, leaving the current app running until a different replacement arrives?
rationale: The patch makes a deliberate availability tradeoff between preventing an unbounded relaunch loop and continuing automatic update recovery; source inspection cannot establish the intended operational retry budget or user recovery expectations.

options.title: Accept the bounded handoff policy
options.body: Approve the five-attempt, hash-keyed terminal policy after real macOS proof confirms the current app stays usable and a new replacement receives a fresh budget.

options.title: Choose a different recovery contract
options.body: Specify a different attempt limit, user-visible recovery path, or retry reset condition before merging the implementation.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded handoff policy
recommendation.body: Approve the five-attempt, hash-keyed terminal policy after real macOS proof confirms the current app stays usable and a new replacement receives a fresh budget.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed macOS retry work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the handoff policy decision.
